from AlgorithmImports import *


class SpyAaplStrategy(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.required_symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig
        ]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        upward_cross = False
        downward_cross = False

        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

            if self.previous_spy_close is not None and self.previous_spy_sma is not None:
                upward_cross = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close > current_spy_sma
                )
                downward_cross = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                    and spy_close < current_spy_sma
                )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.required_symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and downward_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.spy,
                -self.strategy_a_lot,
                tag="Strategy A sell"
            )
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.aapl,
                -self.strategy_b_lot,
                tag="Strategy B sell"
            )
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and upward_cross:
            spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy A buy"
                )
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        quantity,
                        tag="Strategy B buy"
                    )
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

                / current_spy_close

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares, tag="Strategy A buy")
                self.spy_lot = shares

        if (
            self.aapl_lot == 0
            and aapl_red_for_three

            shares = int(20000.0 / float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close))
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares, tag="Strategy B buy")
                self.aapl_lot = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class StrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self._spy_close = None
        self._previous_spy_close = None
        self._spy_sma_value = None
        self._previous_spy_sma = None
        self._spy_sma_ready = False
        self._previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self._aapl_close = None
        self._aapl_red_streak = 0
        self._strategy_a_lot = 0
        self._strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        self._update_market_state(data)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not self._all_bars_present(data):
            return

        if (
            not self.spy_sma.IsReady
            or not self._spy_sma_ready
            or not self._previous_spy_sma_ready
            or self._previous_spy_close is None
            or self._previous_spy_sma is None
            or self._spy_close is None
            or self._aapl_close is None
            or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
        ):
            return

        spy_upward_cross = (
            self._previous_spy_close <= self._previous_spy_sma
            and self._spy_close > self._spy_sma_value
        )

        spy_downward_cross = (
            self._previous_spy_close >= self._previous_spy_sma
            and self._spy_close < self._spy_sma_value
        )

        aapl_buy_reason = self._aapl_red_streak >= 3
        aapl_sell_reason = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0

        # Evaluate sells before buys.
        if self._strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_downward_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.spy,
                -self._strategy_a_lot,
                tag="Strategy A sell"
            )
            self._strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self._strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(
                self.aapl,
                -self._strategy_b_lot,
                tag="Strategy B sell"
            )
            self._strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self._strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_upward_cross:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / self._spy_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(
                    self.spy,
                    quantity,
                    tag="Strategy A buy"
                )
                self._strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self._strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000.0:
                quantity = int(math.floor(20000.0 / self._aapl_close))

                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(
                        self.aapl,
                        quantity,
                        tag="Strategy B buy"
                    )
                    self._strategy_b_lot = quantity

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            close = float(bar.Close)

            self._previous_spy_close = self._spy_close
            self._previous_spy_sma = self._spy_sma_value
            self._previous_spy_sma_ready = self._spy_sma_ready

            self.spy_sma.Update(
                IndicatorDataPoint(bar.EndTime, close)
            )

            self._spy_close = close
            self._spy_sma_value = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            self._spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            close = float(bar.Close)

            if self._aapl_close is not None:
                if close < self._aapl_close:
                    self._aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self._aapl_red_streak = 0

            self._aapl_close = close

            self.aapl_rsi.Update(
                IndicatorDataPoint(bar.EndTime, close)
            )

    def _all_bars_present(self, data):
        return (
            data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.ibm)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.bac)
            and data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aig)
        )
